text: Compiler-tool candidate uses the owning TASTy source for declaration paths and actual canonical source text for UTF-16 span line lookup. Isolated enum-case and class fixtures compare both TASTy traversal orders with independent source/line expectations; a simulated referring-file tree source is corrected. Returning the old reflected tree position was rejected by the regression. Clean JDK25 exposed order-dependent compiler SourceFile line-cache seeding even after correcting paths; canonical text lookup resolves it. Small fixtures did not independently reproduce the hosted path corruption naturally. No inventory/evidence/provenance re-recorded; full clean supported-JDK repository inventory, official full audit, and exact-SHA hosted evidence remain required before closure.
